title: Posting Rules for ComfortLease Rent, Payments and Returned Payments
content:
These posting rules govern the rent ledger of every ComfortLease Equipment Leases agreement.

**Rent charges.** Rent is charged per calendar month on the rent due day. The first month is charged in full at installation.

**Application of payments.** Payments apply to the oldest charge first.

**Returned payments.** A returned payment is charged the returned payment fee, and that fee names the payment that was returned. Each returned payment carries its own fee.

| Leased system | Returned payment fee, per returned payment |
|---|---|
| ComfortLease Gas Furnace | $25.00 |
| ComfortLease Central Air | $25.00 |
| ComfortLease Heat Pump | $25.00 |
| ComfortLease Furnace & Central Air | $25.00 |
| ComfortLease Dual-Fuel System | $25.00 |
| ComfortLease Ductless Multi-Zone | $25.00 |

## Points of judgement

- **First month.** Whatever day of the month the equipment is installed, the first month's rent is charged in full at installation, not in part.
- **Order of application.** A payment is applied to the charge posted earliest; only once that charge is fully paid does the remainder reach the next oldest charge, and so on.
- **Two returns.** Two returned payments on one lease give rise to two returned payment fees, each naming its own returned payment.

## Allocation illustration (hypothetical ledger)

A hypothetical ComfortLease lease shows three unpaid charges, oldest first: charge A of $66.57, charge B of $15.00, charge C of $66.57. A payment of $90.00 posts.

| Charge | Amount | Paid from the $90.00 | Left unpaid |
|---|---|---|---|
| A (oldest) | $66.57 | $66.57 | $0.00 |
| B | $15.00 | $15.00 | $0.00 |
| C (newest) | $66.57 | $8.43 | $58.14 |

If that $90.00 payment is later returned, a returned payment fee of $25.00 is charged naming that payment.
